description: This file sets up and starts an Express-based HTTP server with integrated Socket.IO for real-time communication. It includes route definitions for health checks, authentication, user management, and metrics, along with middleware for security, CORS, logging, rate limiting, and database connection initialization.

classes.name: SocketIOServer
classes.description: The Socket.IO server class used for real-time WebSocket communication.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes and starts the server, setting up middleware, routes, WebSocket, database connection, and listening on the specified port.
